description: This file declares the IFactories interface within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, providing factory methods for creating web request/response and JSON RPC related objects. It also includes deprecated type aliases.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface defining factory methods for creating web-related objects, including HTTP request and response wrappers, file body, and JSON RPC message.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Static method to assign an instance of IFactories.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Static method to access the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Static method to check if the factory instance is available.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Request object.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Response object.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::FileBody object.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::JSONBodyType containing Core::JSONRPC::Message.
